description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). How a name's primary and major nodes evolved across a date range, in one call: strike, polarity and size at each session's close (`every` 'close', default), every N minutes (N of at least 5), or at one `time` (HH:MM ET) each session. Defaults to the last 5 sessions with data; at most 30 sessions and 50 points. Sizes are GEX (QuantGeeks, flow-based) for the nearest expiration. Reports change: a `roll` moves the primary to a new strike on the same side of spot, a `flip` moves it across spot; plus size change, sign pattern and concentration. For one minute's full ladder use quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder; for forward expirations, quantgeeks_get_expiration_map.

every.description: 'close' (default): the last minute of each session; or minutes between samples, at least 5.

from.description: First session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: 5 sessions before the last.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to SPXW), SPY, QQQ, GLD.

time.description: HH:MM US Eastern: one point per session at this time (overrides every).

to.description: Last session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the newest session with stored data (an overnight session counts).

name: quantgeeks_get_node_history
title: Node history
